2.209.1
Map.Name
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.Name attribute specifies the name of a map. This attribute is required. The value of this
attribute MUST be a case-sensitive String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that is a CLS-compliant
identifier [UTR15]. This value MUST be unique among data regions and groups in the Report.
The following is the parent element of the Map.Name attribute.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
